title: Rising urban land surface thermal extremes in a rapidly evolving tropical Indian state

Thermal hotspot dynamics in Odisha, India, reveal a 9% annual expansion in rapidly urbanizing coastal districts, linked to impervious surfaces. Part of the image was generated using Google GeminiAI Pro.
